title: SMIC (Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation)
summary: SMIC (Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation) Type: entity Tags: #semiconductor #foundry #china #smic ## Overview SMIC is China's largest semiconductor foundry, headquartered in Shanghai. It is the key player in China's domestic chip manufacturing capabilities. ## Key Facts - Founded: 2000 - Headquarters: Shanghai, China - Technology Node: 7nm (N+2) in production, working on more advanced nodes - Role: China's primary domestic alternative to TSMC - US Sanctions: Subject to US export controls restricting access to advanced equipment (ASML EUV, Applied Materials) ## Supply Chain Impact - Central to China's semiconductor self-sufficiency strategy - Limited by US sanctions on advanced lithography equipment - Mature node capacity (28nm+) expanding rapidly - Key supplier for domestic Chinese chip design companies ## Related - [[china-semiconductor-localization]] - [[semiconductor-fabrication]] - [[huawei]] - [[tsmc]]
